name: Midori Children's Clinic
tagline: A pediatric clinic that pays careful attention when your child is “not quite themselves”.
credit: Photos are Poly Haven CC0 images (entrance, waiting room, exam room, treatment room) and computer-drawn placeholder rooms (reception, corridor).

reserve.label: Book an appointment
reserve.note: Online booking is available 24 hours a day

info.title: First visit
bring: Health insurance card (or My Number insurance card)
Medical subsidy certificate (if you have one)
steps: Fill in the questionnaire at reception
info.note: If your child has a fever or a cough, please call us before coming.

guide: Welcome to Midori Children's Clinic. Let us show you around, starting from the entrance.
Next to the entrance there is space to leave strollers.
This is reception. On your first visit, please show your health insurance card and, if you have them, your medical subsidy certificate and maternal and child health handbook.
This is the waiting room. You can wait with your stroller.
If your child has a fever or a cough, please call us before coming.
The exam rooms are down the corridor behind reception.
This is an exam room. Parents stay with their child during the examination.
This is the treatment and rest room. Children can lie down here, for example during a drip.
Thank you for visiting. For appointments and questions, tap “Contact”.

pins.title: Front door
pins.text: The entrance has no steps, so you can come in with a stroller.

pins.title: Stroller parking
pins.text: There is space to leave strollers next to the entrance.

pins.title: Reception
pins.text: On your first visit, please show your health insurance card and, if you have them, your medical subsidy certificate and maternal and child health handbook. We will give you a questionnaire here.

pins.title: Spacious waiting area
pins.text: The aisles are wide so you can wait with your stroller.

pins.title: If your child has a fever
pins.text: If your child has a fever or a cough, please call us before coming. We may guide you to a separate room.

pins.title: Call display
pins.text: When your turn is near, your number is shown on the screen.

pins.title: Toilet
pins.text: There is a diaper-changing table and a child seat.

pins.title: Exam room 2
pins.text: On busy days, we also see patients in this room.

pins.title: Examination bed
pins.text: Parents stay with their child during the examination. If your child feels anxious, ask us about being examined on your lap.

pins.title: Medical equipment
pins.text: This equipment is used for treatments such as inhalation. We explain to your child what we are going to do before using it.

pins.title: Monitor
pins.text: We explain test results and images while looking at them together with you.

pins.title: Rest beds
pins.text: Children can lie down here during a drip or when they feel unwell. A parent can stay with them.

pins.title: Soft mats
pins.text: Soft mats cover the floor so small children can play on it.

pins.title: Wall pictures
pins.text: Pictures in gentle colors hang on the walls to help children feel at ease.
